input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Found it: `handleClick` in `ExportButton` calls `exportReport(...).then(...)` but never attaches a `.catch`/error handler. When the fetch in `exportReport` rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws `export failed with status ...`), the promise chain rejects silently, `setBusy(false)` is never reached, and the button is left disabled/greyed out until a full page reload resets component state. The fix should wrap the call in a try/catch (or add `.catch(...)`) that resets `busy` to `false` and surfaces an error toast on failure, so the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.

input.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
input.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. In handleClick, the call to exportReport only sets busy back to false in the .then() success callback, so when the promise rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws), setBusy(false) never runs and the button stays disabled until a page reload. Add a .catch() (or try/finally) that resets busy to false and surfaces an error toast when the export fails.
